meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发发布流水线,把新版本送上 npm 并逐一核验产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要手动跑工作流、还得检查构建产物是否齐全
copy.tagline_en: Trigger the publish pipeline to ship a new npm version and verify its artifacts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you cut releases by running workflows and checking the built artifacts

howto.what: Claude 变成 oh-my-opencode 的发布管理员:收到一个版本选择后触发 GitHub Actions 发布工作流,起草发布说明并写进 GitHub release,发 Discord 公告,再逐项核对 npm 上发布的包和版本。
howto.when: 当你提到 “publish”、“release”、“deploy” 等关键词,或要求把 oh-my-opencode 发布到 npm 时接管。未给出 patch、minor、major 或显式版本号时,它会先停下索要一个。

say.note: 触发发布工作流并完成后续验证。
按你指定的显式版本号发布。
发布 minor 版本并发 Discord 公告。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes release manager for oh-my-opencode: given a version selector it triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, drafts release notes into the GitHub release, posts a Discord announcement, and verifies the published npm packages and versions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "publish", "release", "deploy" etc., or ask to ship oh-my-opencode to npm. If no patch/minor/major or explicit version is given, it stops and asks for one.

say_en.note: Triggers the publish workflow and runs verification.
Publishes that exact version via the workflow.
Ships a minor release and announces it on Discord.
